Sandbox_WaterPipes_IrrigationRange_toolt: Sets the default square area covered by each pipe for irrigation, plowing, crop care, fertilization, and cleanup. Individual pipes can override it from their context menu. Larger ranges require each pipe to maintain more squares.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_ShowCleanup: Show the Area Cleanup pipe switch
Sandbox_WaterPipes_ShowCleanup_tooltip: Off by default. When enabled, placed pipes show an Area Cleanup switch in their context menu. Area Cleanup is destructive: enabled pipes periodically delete the selected categories within their configured range.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_EnableAutoFarming_too: Off by default. When enabled, pipe context menus and inventories expose Auto-Sow, Auto-Harvest, and Automatic Farming Settings. Disabling the module stops all automatic farming work and hides those controls without erasing per-pipe settings.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_CleanupVegetation: Area Cleanup: weeds and removable vegetation
Sandbox_WaterPipes_CleanupVegetation_too: Removes weeds, grass overlays, and removable vegetation. Planted crops are preserved.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_CleanupTrees_tooltip: Removes trees within the range of pipes that have Area Cleanup enabled.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_CleanupZombies_toolti: Removes living zombies that enter the range of pipes with Area Cleanup enabled.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_CleanupCorpses_toolti: Removes zombie corpses. Animal corpses are preserved.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_CleanupBlood_tooltip: Removes blood stains within the range of pipes that have Area Cleanup enabled.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_CleanupGroundItems_to: Danger: permanently deletes every dropped ground item within the range of pipes that have Area Cleanup enabled.
Sandbox_WaterPipes_InfiniteRevive: Infinite revive plants from rotten, dead, or harvested states
Sandbox_WaterPipes_InfiniteReviveToSeede: Revive harvested plants to seeded state (requires Infinite Revive)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_InfinitePestCare: Infinite pest care without any cost
Sandbox_WaterPipes_InfiniteNoRotten: Plants near pipes will live forever and never rot
Sandbox_WaterPipes_InfiniteInstantGrowUp: Plants will instantly grow to harvest state (reload required)
Sandbox_WaterPipes_PreventFarmlandDestru: Prevents zombies and vehicles from trampling tilled land and its crops. Normal harvesting, decay, and deliberate removal by players are unaffected.
